role_dispositions.destination: Keep the frozen baseline unchanged; a new thin runtime envelope activates only the minimum tested subset.
Strategic Context Orchestration delegates materially strategic/ambiguous comparisons to Strategic Decision Envelope v1 before quest mechanics.
XMind remains the discretionary long-horizon prior/map evidence and never overrides mandatory reality or factual live owners.
Envelope inputs are ephemeral references to existing owners/live sources; no truth is copied into a new owner.
Valid focus has continuity preference; mandatory preemption changes immediate attention without implicit focus mutation; strategic switches remain user-directed.
Difficulty/reward/timing/evidence/anti-farming/lifecycle semantics are untouched and execute only after outcome selection.
Envelope outputs carry persistent_action_authorized=false; existing external mutation gates remain unchanged.
No Neon schema/table/event type or generic evidence persistence is added; envelope state is working-context only.
Reverting the candidate restores the exact base behavior with no data migration.

capability_probes.assertion: A valid current focus remains the execution default when a new attractive opportunity does not justify switching cost/lost momentum.
A verified XMind-aligned discretionary direction cannot outrank a genuine hard external deadline or other mandatory reality gate.
Decision-critical uncertainty selects one small reversible information-gaining test when available rather than fabricating a strategic winner.
Switching cost and forward momentum matter for a viable course, but sunk cost alone cannot protect an invalid/disproven course.
Keep-current-course/do-nothing remains an explicit eligible outcome when credible and may be best-supported.
Direct real-world action outranks System engineering unless engineering has demonstrated marginal execution benefit over its opportunity cost.
Conflicting credible goals require explicit scarce-resource allocation rather than silently stacking all goals.
Insufficient decision-critical evidence returns UNKNOWN_NO_COMMIT when no bounded information test can resolve it.
Open/focus, difficulty, reward, timing, evidence, anti-farming and external-write semantics remain unchanged.
Recorded base SHA is a complete rollback point and the slice needs no data migration.
